feeds.title: Kids Hair Play Blog
feeds.description: We are a salon designed exclusively for young people, from babies to teens. Our child-friendly environment takes the stress out of haircuts and instead turns them from a chore into a fun experience. Being child-centered means not only having play areas, toys, games, entertainment, and specially themed chairs, but we also want all our clients to feel safe and special - from the moment they walk through our doors until they leave looking forward to their next visit.

feeds.title: Snip Its Blog
feeds.description: Snip-Its is a magical place for kids and a place moms and dads trust for great haircuts. Kids love going to Snip-its because there's so much to see and do, and parents feel great knowing their children are in good hands with our talented, kid-focused stylists.

feeds.title: Sit Still Kids Blog
feeds.description: We believe that awesome haircuts and good times can be had by all. At Sit Still, it's our mission to provide the whole family with positive experiences and high-quality styles in a welcoming, inclusive environment filled with all things cool.

feeds.title: KidSnips Blog
feeds.description: KidSnips is the Chicago area's top hair salon for kids' haircuts, special services, and kid-friendly hair products. It's locally-owned and Mom-owned. And because it's also mom-run we know kids. So, we have car-shaped styling chairs, tablets loaded with fun stuff for kids to do, and we only hire stylists who love children and who make getting a kid's haircut an awesome experience for ALL.
